description: Urban Development Authority - Expansion & Declaration of part of Wellawaya Pradeshiya Sabha area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the declaration of an Urban Development Area in Wellawaya. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, Grama Niladhari divisions, and metes and bounds of the designated area. The notification is made under the Urban Development Authority Law, but the core content focuses on land development and property delineation rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or legal/regulatory frameworks.
